name: Direct provider
summary: The agent calls one model lab's API (for example Anthropic, OpenAI or Google) with that lab's own SDK and key, with no gateway in between. It is the simplest setup: one account, one bill and the lab's newest features on day one. The cost is lock-in to one provider and no automatic fallback when it has an outage.
how: Create an API key with one model lab
Install that lab's SDK or call its HTTP API
Point the agent's model setting at the lab's endpoint
Handle retries and rate limits in your own code
facts: Simplest and newest features, but single-vendor
goodFor: Fewest moving parts and third parties
watchOut: One provider outage stops the agent
Switching models later means code changes
Spend and keys tracked per vendor
